:JUDGMENT:

This Claim Petition is filed by the Petitioner against the Respondents under Section 166 of the Motor Vehicles Act seeking Compensation of Rs.3,00,000/- for the injuries sustained in the Road Traffic accident.

2. The substance of averments made in the Petition is as under:
That on 22-12-2022 at about 12.00 p.m., the Petitioner was working as home guard and was on duty at BB road, Kempapura bus stop, by that time the bus bearing No.AP-21-Z- 0856 came to the said bus stand stopped the same, the driver of the bus while getting the passengers into the bus without closing the luggage door towards left of the bus, started moving the bus, keeping the luggage door open and touched the luggage door to the fore head of the petitioner.
Consequently, she fell down and sustained injuries to head and right hand.
Immediately after the accident, the Petitioner was admitted to Prolife Multi Speciality hospital, wherein she was treated as an inpatient from 22.12.2022 to 23.12.2022.
She has spent Rs.50,000/- towards medical treatment, conveyance and the incidental expenses.
3. Prior to the accident, the Petitioner was hale and healthy and she was working as home guard in police department and was earning Rs.23,000/- per month.
Due to the accident, she has sustained grievous injuries causing permanent disablement.
4. The Respondent No.1 is the driver under the employment with the respondent No.2, they are jointly and severally liable to pay the compensation to the Petitioner.
Hence, this Petition.

5. In pursuance of service of notice to the Respondents, Respondent No.1 and 2 remained absent,
hence they were placed exparte.
6. In order to substantiate the case of the Petitioner, the Petitioner got examined herself as P.W.1 and got marked 17 documents as per Ex.P.1 to P.17 and closed her side evidence.

7. Having heard the arguments and upon careful consideration of the entire materials placed on record, following points are taken up for determination of this case:
8.

The points which arise for my consideration in this case are ;-
1. Whether the Petitioner proves that she sustained injuries on 22.12-2022 at about 12-00 p.m. at BB Road, Kempapura bus stop, Bangalore city, in an accident arising due to rash and negligent driving of driver of Bus bearing No.AP-21-Z-0856?

2 2.

sentences.text: Whether the petitioner is entitled for the compensation?
If so.
How much and from whom?

3. What Order or Award?
9.

My finding to the above points are as under:
Point No.1 : In the Affirmative Point No.2 : Partly in the Affirmative Point No. 3 : As per the Final Order for the following :
REASONS 10. Point No. 1 : It is the case of the Petitioner that she had sustained injuries in the Road Traffic accident that occurred on 22-12-2022 at about 12-00 p.m., due to the rash and negligent driving of the bus bearing No.AP-21-Z-0856 by its driver.
11. In order to prove the case of the Petitioner, she got examined herself as P.W.1 and got marked documents as per Ex.P.1 to Ex.P-17.
She has re-iterated the Petition averments in her chief-affidavit.

Ex.P-1 is the true copy of FIR with complaint, Ex.P.2 is the true copy of charge sheet, Ex.P3 is the true copy of witness statement, Ex.P.4 is the true copy of mahazar, Ex.P.5 is the true copy of notice issued u/s 133 of MV Act, Ex.P.6 is the reply given to notice.

Ex.P.7 is the true copy of Indemnity bond, Ex.P.8 and 9 are true copy of witness statement, Ex.P.10 is the true copy of wound certificate,
Ex.P.11 is the IP bill, Ex.P.12 is advance receipt, Ex.P.13 is the prescriptions, Ex.P.14 is invoices,
Ex.P.15 is discharge summary, Ex.P.16 is medical certificate and Ex.P.17 is photographs.

12. Upon going through Ex.P.1 FIR with Complaint, they justify the fact that on the complaint lodged before Hebbal Traffic Police Station, the Head Constable of the concerned Police Station has registered the case against the driver of bus bearing Regn. No.AP-21-Z-0856 for the offences punishable under Sec.279, 337 of IPC.

The Ex.P.2 is the true copy of Charge sheet shows that after thorough investigation, the Head Constable of Hebbal Traffic Police Station has Charge-sheeted the driver of the offending bus for the offences punishable under Sec.279, 337 of IPC.
Ex.P.4 is the Spot mahazar which shows that mahazar was drawn in the presence of panchas.
The Ex.P.10 is the wound certificate, which shows that petitioner has sustained simple injuries.
13. Further, it is noted above that inspite of valid service of notice upon them, the respondents have not chosen to contest the petition.
Such being the case, the averments made in the petition and the evidence both oral and documentary placed on hand by the petitioner remained unchallenged and uncontraverted.

Therefore, having regard to the facts and circumstances of the case and the deposition and documents exhibited, this Tribunal is of the considered opinion that the accident is occurred by the rash and negligent driving of the offending vehicle bearing No.AP-21-Z-0856 by its driver and in the said accident, the Petitioner had sustained simple injuries.

Accordingly, I answer Point No.1 in the 'Affirmative'.
14. Point No. 2 : As the petitioner has proved that the accident has occurred due to the rash and negligent driving of the offending bus by its driver, the Petitioner is entitled for compensation.

sentences.text: In the petition, the Petitioner has shown her age as 59 years.
She has not produced any document to prove her age.
As per police and medical documents, her age is mentioned as 59 years.

Hence, the age of the Petitioner as on the date of accident was taken as 59 years and the same is to be taken for consideration.
16.
Further, the petitioner has averred that she was working as home guard in the department of police, Bangalore and was earning Rs.23,000/- per month.
In this regard, she has not produced any document to prove her income.

Therefore, in the absence of proof of income, the notional income to be assessed as per the guidelines of Karnataka State Legal Service Authority i.e., Rs.15,500/-p.m. as the accident has been occurred in the year of 2022, for the purpose of assessment of compensation.
17. With this background, the quantum of compensation to which the Petitioner is entitled may be adjudicated.
It is to be noted here that according to the petitioner, she has sustained grievous injuries.
Ex.P.7 wound certificate shows that the Petitioner had sustained following injuries.

1. CLW over left side forehead 2. Swelling over right parietal region.
Wherein the doctor has opined that injuries are simple in nature.
18.
In order to prove the gravity of the injuries, the Petitioner is expected to produce documents.
The petitioner has deposed that she incurred expenditure of Rs.50,000/- for her treatment and other expenses.
In this regard she has produced IP Bills at Ex.P.11 amounting to Rs.5151/- and invoices at Ex.P.14 amounting to Rs.3887/- totally amounting to Rs.9038/-.
As there is no serious dispute with regard to the medical bills and upon careful consideration, the petitioner is entitled for Rs.9038/-towards medical expenses.

19. The petitioner has not examined any doctor and in the absence of physical disability and considering the nature of injury sustained by the Petitioner and the medical expenses incurred for the treatment.
As per the Ex.P15 discharge summary, she was admitted on 22.12.2022 and discharged on 23.12.2022.

Keeping in mind all these factors and the expenses incurred for Food and other charges, this Tribunal is of the opinion that awarding global compensation of Rs.40,000/-
would be just and proper.

20. Regarding Liability: This Court has arrived at the conclusion that the accident has been occurred by the rash and negligent driving on the part of the driver of the offending bus bearing No.AP-21-Z-0856.
Further, there is no dispute about the validity of the Insurance Policy of the offending vehicle as on the date of accident.
Therefore, Respondent No.2 being the owner cum internal insurer of the offending vehicle is liable to pay compensation to the Petitioner.

Accordingly,
I answer Point No.2 "Partly in the Affirmative".
21.POINT No.3 :

In view of my findings on Point No.1 and 2, I proceed to pass the following:

sentences.text:
The Claim Petition filed by the Petitioner of M.V. Act is hereby allowed in part with costs.
 The Petitioner is entitled for  Compensation of Rs.40,000/- along with interest at the rate of 6% per annum from the date of the Petition till the date of deposit of Award amount.
The Respondent No.1 and 2 are jointly and severally liable to pay the compensation amount to the Petitioner.
The Respondent No.2 being the insurer of the offending vehicle, is directed to deposit the Award amount and interest within 60 days from the date of the Award.
After being deposit of the Award amount and interest by the Respondent No.2, entire award amount is ordered to be paid to the Petitioner by way of E- payment and after proper identification.
The Advocate fee is fixed at Rs.1,000/-.
Draw Award accordingly.
